title: Joshua Tree National Park Trip Planner Printable, Joshua Tree Itinerary, Best Day Hikes, Desert Camping Guide, California Travel PDF
description:
Planning a first trip to Joshua Tree National Park? This 30-page printable guide puts the whole trip on paper: when to go, the three entrances, passes and campgrounds, where to stay, how to spend 1, 2 or 3 days, and how to stay safe in a desert park with no water, gas or food inside.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- The park at a glance: where the Mojave and Colorado deserts meet, the West, North and Cottonwood entrances, and rough driving times from Palm Springs, Los Angeles, San Diego and Phoenix
- When to go, season by season: the October to April main season, summer heat, spring break and holiday crowds
- Passes and fees (2026 prices) and why the entrance stations take cards only
- All eight park campgrounds in one table, with a booking tracker you fill in
- Getting around and where to stay: no shuttle, no gas, driving times inside the park, gateway towns and a comparison page
- Sample 1, 2 and 3-day plans, plus a hot-day plan and a windy-day plan
- Stargazing in a dark sky park
- 12 day hikes and walks, easy to hard, from the Cholla Cactus Garden and Hidden Valley to Ryan Mountain and Lost Palms Oasis, with distance in mi and km and climb in ft and m, from NPS figures
- Desert safety with a water-carry worksheet, rock scrambling, wildlife and plants, visiting with kids and dogs
- Desert packing list, day planner, hike log, budget and trip checklist

WHAT YOU GET
- US Letter and A4 versions
- Mobile edition, sized for reading on your phone
- Color and printer-friendly (low ink) versions
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
Checked against nps.gov in November 2026. Fees, campground rules and trail conditions change, so check the official park website for your dates before you go. No maps or GPS files. Not affiliated with the National Park Service. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable hiking guides in our Etsy shop.
